title: Histology and clinical features classify recorded HER2-positive recurrence in a separate cohort
summary: A ResNet50-based model combined histology features with clinical data to classify recorded recurrence or metastasis in HER2-positive breast cancer. Developed in 127 patients, it achieved a reported AUC of 0.72 in 123 TCGA patients. The result is retrospective clinical validation, without a time-calibrated recurrence forecast or demonstrated treatment benefit.
organization: Chifeng Municipal Hospital; Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences; Genies (Beijing) Co., Ltd.

evidence.tested: ResNet50 patch features were fused with clinical variables; patch scores were averaged per slide. Separate TCGA data supplied the represented AUC.
evidence.unknown: Internal two-fold splitting is described in terms of patches/samples without established patient separation. Follow-up horizons and censoring are not adequately specified for a time-calibrated prognosis. Histology heterogeneity and different cohort characteristics limit reproducibility. No prospective validation, avoided treatment or improved clinical outcomes were measured.
evidence.ai_role: Learned image features and multimodal fusion enable the source-specific classification of recorded recurrence outcomes.
